description: This file defines the 'Observable' class, an implementation of the observer pattern, allowing objects to be observed for changes. It provides methods for adding, removing, and notifying observers, with concurrency considerations.

classes.name: Observable
classes.description: A final class implementing an observable pattern with thread-safe observer management, allowing observers to register, deregister, and be notified of changes.

methods.description: Default constructor initializing the observable object.

methods.description: Adds a new observer to the list if it is not already present.

methods.name: clearChanged
methods.description: Resets the changed flag to indicate no recent change.

methods.name: deleteObserver
methods.description: Removes a specific observer from the list.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the observable object has been marked as changed.

methods.description: Marks the observable as having changed.
